description: Shared definitions for the MIRA discourse-graph lexicons. DRAFT — derived by hand from schema/mira.yaml; not yet adopted or published. See schema/atproto/SPEC.md.

ref.description: A reference from one MIRA record to another. Weak by default (uri only, follows the latest version); strong when 'cid' is present (pins one immutable version, for citation that must not drift). Compatible with com.atproto.repo.strongRef.

uri.description: AT-URI of the target record, e.g. at://did:plc:abc/science.mira.claim/3k...

cid.description: Optional content hash pinning a specific version of the target (makes this a strong ref).

externalRef.description: A pointer to a resource that lives outside the AT Protocol network — a URL, DOI, dataset locator, or document. Embodies MIRA's 'pointers, not payloads' rule for content held off-PDS.

mediaType.description: Optional MIME type of the resource, e.g. text/html, application/pdf.

cid.description: Optional content hash for integrity, if known.

dataArtifact.description: The literal data an observation rests on — a figure, blot, image, or dataset (MIRA observationBase, range prov:Entity). Primary form is an external URL ('pointers, not payloads'); a PDS blob is permitted for small artifacts. At least one of 'uri' or 'blob' is expected.

uri.description: External locator of the artifact (image/dataset URL). Preferred for large data.

blob.description: Optional inline blob, only for small artifacts hosted on the author's PDS.

description.description: Optional caption / what the artifact shows.

agent.description: An explicit scientific author or curator. Used for MIRA 'creator' ONLY when the scientific author differs from the signing repo account (e.g. a curator importing a third party's claim), and for SourceDocument authors. When absent on a node, the creator is the repo's DID by construction.

did.description: AT Protocol DID, if the agent has one.

orcid.description: ORCID URI, e.g. https://orcid.org/0000-0002-1825-0097 — the identity bridge for researchers without a DID.
